name: cardume
description: Open-source agents, skills, commands and safety hooks for Claude Code, with proportional spec-driven delivery and an independent verifier

plugins.name: cardume-all
plugins.description: The whole suite: installs every Cardume plugin at once

plugins.name: cardume-core
plugins.description: Delivery flow (spec, tasks, verify, gate, release), safety hooks, routing, planning, debugging and core commands

plugins.name: cardume-frontend
plugins.description: UI design (design-flow), websites, React/Next.js, mobile, performance, SEO/GEO, i18n

plugins.name: cardume-backend
plugins.description: APIs, databases, Node.js, Java/Spring, Rust, MCP servers

plugins.name: cardume-data
plugins.description: BigQuery, lakehouse, Airflow, GCP data observability, data PR review, data and AI project audits

plugins.name: cardume-platform
plugins.description: DevOps, Terraform, Kubernetes, FinOps, cloud assessment, project bootstrap, IaC review, observability (OpenTelemetry, SLOs, alerts)

plugins.name: cardume-qa
plugins.description: Testing, TDD, E2E with Playwright, security (audit, scanning, red team)

plugins.name: cardume-games
plugins.description: Game development: engine choice, game loop, physics, game feel, performance, multiplayer and shipping
